market_pulse.note: About $61,716 early Friday, down 3.39% over 24 hours and near its lowest level since July (Reuters via Yahoo Finance; Coin Gabbar).
About $1,746, down 3.3% over 24 hours, per CoinGecko data cited Friday (Coin Gabbar).
About $2.2 trillion, down 1.7% over 24 hours, per CoinGecko data cited Friday (Coin Gabbar).
About 55.8% on CoinGecko's measure early Friday UTC; Ether's share was 9.57% (Coin Gabbar).

themes.title: Asian rout hits crypto
themes.summary: Bitcoin slipped below $62,000 as Asian stock markets lost more than $1 trillion, led by Japan, South Korea and Taiwan, extending Thursday's AI-led selloff (Coin Gabbar; Reuters via Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Down about 20% in November
themes.summary: Bitcoin has fallen more than 20% from about $81,000 at the start of November, and a 'death cross' has formed on its chart (U.Today; Altcoin Buzz).

themes.title: Fed hike nearly priced in
themes.summary: CME FedWatch shows a 98.4% chance of a December rate increase after hotter October inflation, a backdrop cited for pressure on crypto (Reuters via Yahoo Finance; U.Today).

themes.title: CFTC tightens on-chain venues
themes.summary: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said on-chain platforms such as Hyperliquid must register or partner with licensed exchanges to serve U.S. retail users (Coin Gabbar).

themes.title: Extreme fear, $391M liquidated
themes.summary: The Fear and Greed Index sits at 10 to 12, in extreme fear, and more than $391 million of positions were liquidated over 24 hours, mostly longs (Coin Gabbar; U.Today).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin near $61,700 and Ether near $1,746, both down more than 3% over 24 hours (Reuters via Yahoo Finance; Coin Gabbar).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: XRP near $0.96, down 2.4%; NEAR fell 7.9% and Uniswap 6.3% over 24 hours (Coin Gabbar).

categories.name: DeFi
categories.note: DeFi market cap about $56 billion, down roughly 3% to 4.5% over 24 hours (Coin Gabbar).

categories.name: Stablecoins
categories.note: Stablecoin market cap about $280.7 billion, down 0.6% (Coin Gabbar).

watch_list.why: Bitcoin has traded between about $62,000 and $65,000 since Nov. 14 and is now testing the low end; analysts cite $60,000 as the next support (U.Today; COINOTAG).
Bank of Japan signals of more rate hikes and possible yen intervention, with U.S. 10-year yields above 5%, raise the risk of a carry-trade unwind (Coin Gabbar).
Bitcoin is on track for a seventh straight weekly loss, and U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen about $2.6 billion of November outflows (Altcoin Buzz; KuCoin).

movers.name: CHUNKEE
movers.note: Top gainer, up about 224% over 24 hours per CoinGecko (Coin Gabbar).

movers.name: Anthropic PreStocks (ANTHROPIC)
movers.note: Tokenized pre-IPO Anthropic exposure fell about 30.9% after the real shares began trading (Coin Gabbar).
